title: Updated Feeding Schedule — November 2026
body: Beginning November 1, the 29-gallon Balance Experiment transitions from Monday, Wednesday, and Friday feeding to Sunday, Tuesday, and Thursday. The change accommodates work scheduling, improves feeding observations, and retains individualized feeding for the recovering betta.
quick_facts: Feeding: Sunday and Thursday fish flakes and algae wafers; Tuesday brine shrimp, bloodworms and Shrimp Cuisine; targeted betta feeding as needed; fertilizer: Tuesday, NilocG Thrive S, 4 pumps weekly
